sources.title: colqwen2-v0.1: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview colqwen2-v0.1 is an untrained base vision-language model for document retrieval built by vidore that extends Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct to generate ColBERT-style multi-vector representations of documents and queries. The model accepts dynamic image resolutions without aspect ratio distortion, supporting up to 768 image patches maximum per document to balance quality against memory ...

sources.snippet: Overview colqwen2.5-v0.2 is a visual document retrieval model created by vidore that generates ColBERT-style multi-vector representations of images and text. It extends Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct with a novel training strategy designed to efficiently index documents from their visual features.
